item.title: Viridian Tepezza Rival Thyroid Eye Disease
item.description:
• Summary: Viridian Therapeutics reported positive results from a second Phrase 3 trial of its anti‑IGF‑1R antibody elegrobart (VRDN‑001) for chronic thyroid eye disease (TED). The drug showed significant improvement in proptosis and overall response compared to placebo. These data position elegrobart as a potential rival to Horizon Therapeutics' Tepezza (teprotumumab), and the company plans to submit for FDA approval.
  • MoAs: Insulin‑like growth factor‑1 receptor (IGF‑1R) blockade
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, Fierce Biotech
